name: Casualties: Unknown
short: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.
about: Survive a Harsh World    Each layer brings its own challenges, adapt and descend.      Simulated Limb and Cardiovascular Systems    Injuries are unavoidable. You will have to bandage yourself, fight infected wounds, and stabilize blood loss before losing consciousness. Additionally, your mood can greatly affect your chances of survival, too much doom and gloom will make your life harder.            Craft to Survive    As a creature capable of reason, using tools will allow you to travel the cavernous layers more efficiently. In case you start bleeding out, the flora will provide great resources to patch yourself up.      Explore at Your Own Risk    Previous expeditions have left some good loot behind. But even helpful things can prove to be your death.     Uncover the Truth    What actually lies at the end of this journey? And what becomes of you if you are to succeed?             Features     An entirely simulated cardiovascular and limb damage system    Character traits to increase on your run: Intelligence, Strength, and Resilience    Robust crafting mechanics to increase your odds of survival    3 characters with their own distinct playstyles    11 layers of an alien planet with their own challenges and dangers    300 items to find on your runs    Adjustable loot and danger values accessible on the main menu
min_req: Minimum:     OS:  Windows 10    Processor:  Intel Core i3-8130U 2.20 GHz    Storage:  500 MB available space    Additional Notes:  16x9, 16x10, Ultrawide screens supported
